links.comparator_used: Four other prompting strategies tested with GPT-4o (the abstract does not describe them; a baseline without injected knowledge is presumably among the five)
links.outcome: ICD coding accuracy for primary diagnosis, secondary diagnosis and surgical procedure coding
links.effect: Contextual prompting tailored to medical specialties was best with GPT-4o, with accuracies of 84%, 85% and 82% for the three coding tasks. Accuracies for the other strategies are not given in the abstract.
links.quote: Contextual prompting tailored to medical specialties achieved the best performance with GPT-4o, with accuracies of 84%, 85%, and 82% for the three coding tasks.
